translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Aad'd'eeda eranchcha asaa mala Asay oonee? Yewotuwaa ubbaa biletsaa eriyaawe oonee? Aad'd'eeda eratetsay pashikkissiide, d'umeedda som"uwaa poo'issee.
Kaatiyaw azazetta; ayaw gooppe, azazettanaw neeni kase S'oossaa sintsan c'aak'k'a uttaadda.
Ubbaa wode iita oosuwaa ootsoppa; ayaw gooppe, kaatii bare koyeeddawaa ootsanaw danddayiyaa diraw, neeni Aa sintsappe elle d'ayana.
Ubbabaa ootsanaw kaatiyaw maatay de'ee; yaatina, «Ayaw hawaa ootsaaddii?» yaagiide Aa oochchanaw danddayiyaawe oonee?
Aa azazuwaa poliyaa uray murettena; aad'd'eeda eranchcha Asay likke gidiyaa wodiyaanne ootsiyaa ogiyaa eree.
Itti asaa bollan dees'o metuu gakkinttonne, yewuwaa ubbaw aw Aa wodiinne Aa ogii ogii de'ee.
Sintsappe hanana timbbitiyaa eriyaawe baawa; hewaa diraw, «Hawe hanana» giide odanaw danddayiyaawe oonee?

Shemppuu shaakkettiide biyaa gallassi oyk'k'iide, te"anaw danddayiyaa Asay baawa; woy hayk'k'uu bare gallassan yeennaadan digganaw danddayiyaa asaykka baawa. Hewe ooninne kessi akkanaw danddayenna olaa. Hewaa diraw, hayk'k'uwaa sintsan iitatetsi iitaa ootsiyaa uraa ashshi akkena.
Saluwaa gufantsan haniyaawaa ubbaa taani akeekaade k'oppiyaa wode, itti Asay barew mooddiyaa maataa hara asaa k'ohanaw go'ettiyaawaa be'aad.

K'ay iita asatuu bonchchuwaan moogettishina be'aad. Hewaappe aad'd'iyaawekka k'ay, mooguwaappe simmiyaa wode, unttunttu he iitatetsaa ootseedda katamaa Asay shiik'iide, unttuntta sabbishshina sisaad. Hewe ubbaykka mela.
Aassi halchchiide iitabaa ootsiyaa gaasuu, iitabaa ootseedda asatuwaa ellekka muriyaabay baynna diraassa.
Nagaranchchay s'eetu gede iitabaa ootsishina, Aa laytsay aduk'k'ooppekka, S'oossaw yayyiyaawanttoo sa'ay lo"anawaa taani eray.
Iitatuu S'oossaa yayyenna diraw, sarotetsay unttunttoo baawa; S'oossaw unttunttu yayyenna diraw, unttunttu barekka kuwaadan k'aammana.
Ha sa'aan oosettiyaa itti hadabay de'ee; hewekka, geeshsha asatuu nagaranchchatoo yiyaa muruwaa akkina, nagaranchchatuu k'ay, geeshshatoo yiyaa lo"obaa akkiino. Ha ubbaykka mela.

Hewaa diraw, Asay bare de'uwaan nashetooppe lo"a gaade k'ofaa immay; ayaw gooppe, Asay miyaawaappe, ushiyaawaappenne barena nashechchiyaawaappe aad'd'eeda lo"obay aw saluwaappe garssa baggana haray baawa. S'oossay aw immeedda laytsan I daaburiide demmeeddawaan hewaadan ootsooppe, nashetanaw danddayee.
Taani aad'd'eeda eratetsay ayentto eranawunne Asay ha sa'aa bollan daaburiyaa daaburaa akeekanaw halchchaad; wurssetsan Asay gem"ishuwaa d'ayiide ootsiyaa duus's'enna oosuu de'iyaawaa be'aad.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan, S'oossay ootseeddawaa ubbaa be'aad. K'ay saluwaappe garssa baggan oosetteedda oosuwaa Asay pilggiide eranaw danddayennawaa eraad. Asi ay keeshshaa daaburiide pilggi s'eellooppenne, Aa biletsaa eranaw danddayenna. K'ay aad'd'eeda eranchcha asay, «Taani hawaa eray» gooppenne, I eranaw danddayenna.
